use_when: At the left of the header on every page, using the lockup at 32px high.
Use the mark on its own where there's no room for the wordmark, such as a collapsed sidebar, an app icon or a favicon.

dont_use_when.when: For listing, room or place photos: use the Image component instead.
For a person's profile photo: use the Avatar component instead.
As a decorative icon or bullet: use an icon from the Icon Library instead.

variant_intent.lockup: default; mark and wordmark, the header logo

a11y.fact: The mark is a native . Its alt defaults to an empty string in the lockup, where the wordmark text beside it names the logo, and to "Horizon Stays" in the mark-only variant; the alt prop overrides either.
The mark image carries explicit width and height of 32, its intrinsic size.
The wordmark is real text content, so it is the lockup's accessible name and is selectable.
